# Constanta — Messenger on Django

> Modern messenger with private chats, group chats, file sharing, and task lists.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/hahahai94/Constanta
- License: MIT
- Stack: Django 6, Python 3.14, PostgreSQL, Bootstrap 5

## Features

- Private messaging with auto-polling every 2 seconds
- Group chats with roles (creator, admin, member)
- File sharing with attachment download
- Task lists per user
- User directory and profiles
- Avatar upload (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP)

## Project

Constanta is a real-time messaging application built with Django. It uses server-side rendering with Django Templates and Bootstrap 5 for the frontend, and an auto-polling mechanism for real-time updates. File uploads are validated by magic bytes and hashed with SHA256 for deduplication.
